title: The Faithful Ledger
author: Y. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Freya Thackeray, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
